journey.title: Buy a mug as a guest
steps: Add the "Harbor Mug" to the cart.
Open the cart and continue to checkout.
Enter buyer@example.test as the email and pay with the test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.

observations.name: final_heading
observations.instruction: Read the main heading (h1) of the page you are on and store its text as 'final_heading'.

observations.name: order_count
observations.instruction: Count the order rows on the orders page (not the header row) and store the number as 'order_count'. If there are no order rows at all, store the word NONE as 'order_count'.

observations.name: charged_total
observations.instruction: Add up every amount in the Charged column of the orders page and store the total as 'charged_total'. If there are no order rows at all, store the word NONE as 'charged_total'.
